purpose: Define the canonical site-wide style configuration as an explicit identity/revision separate from individual Element/content semantics.

topics.name: Expose Style Identity
topics.purpose: Define the canonical site-wide style configuration as an explicit identity/revision separate from individual Element/content semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Each site-wide style definition has an explicit identity/revision.
semantics.token_rule: Colors, spacing, typography and other design tokens are explicit.
semantics.element_rule: Style affects presentation only unless a component explicitly maps a token to semantic behavior.
semantics.authority_rule: Style editing grants no content/domain authority.
semantics.single_rule: One canonical active site-wide style exists per declared site scope/profile.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: multiple styles silently compete by load order
